description.value: The Gardens at HCP is a not-for-profit botanical garden and home to the Pacific Horticulture College, set on a scenic property in Saanich near Victoria. Features include a Japanese garden with Takata ponds, a W̱SÁNEĆ Ethnobotany Trail, a children's garden, a gift shop, a library, and an on-site partner restaurant. The ambling garden paths make for a pleasant stop, and touring the grounds takes roughly an hour.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (25 spaces) at 33m. Total: 25 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active botanical garden and horticulture centre at 505 Quayle Rd, Victoria, with recent news posts through May 2026 and active hiring. The hours/admission page confirms a partner restaurant on site ('The Charlotte & The Quail') and notes most pathways are wheelchair and stroller friendly. Phone and address on the website match OSM. No evidence found on the website for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those are left null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active botanical garden and horticulture centre in Victoria with on-site restaurant, gift shop, and scenic grounds—a worthwhile attraction stop for touring cyclists on southern Vancouver Island.

Café or food on site.detail: Partner restaurant The Charlotte & The Quail is on site, with its own phone line and menu at charlotteandthequail.ca

wow_evidence: Dupe winner (current branding) over Horticulture Centre of the Pacific (2815d95224). Nine acres of themed gardens incl. Takata Japanese garden, ethnobotany trail, college on site.
blurb: Botanical gardens with Takata Japanese garden and W̱SÁNEĆ Ethnobotany Trail.
